::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 6th [1882]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/  Yonge 1882 / 2
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I with I could have made room for this very amusing account while it is fresh, but my October [number](organizations/other_52.qmd) is full, and I must give it up

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ 9 College Green/ Worcester, stamp and postmark cut out, reverse postmarked Worcester 7 September 1882.  Endorsed in ink on front of letter ‘Enclosure to be burnt 21.11.9.’
